During the config_reload from test_po_update, seeing following error:

args = (<MultiAsicSonicHost sfd-vt2-lc0>,)
kwargs = {'ignore_loganalyzer': None, 'safe_reload': True}, loganalyzer = None

    @wraps(func)
    def decorated(*args, **kwargs):
        """
        try to fetch loganalyzer instances from kwargs:
        if ignore_loganalyzer is not passed, do nothing but execute the decorated function.
        if ignore_loganalyzer is passed, to avoid 'unexpected keyword argument error',
            delete the ignore_loganalyzer from kwargs so that it would not be passed to the decorated function,
            and set ignore_loganalyzer markers before and after the decorated function on all log analyzer instances.
        """

        loganalyzer = None
        if 'ignore_loganalyzer' in kwargs and kwargs['ignore_loganalyzer'] is not None:
            loganalyzer = kwargs['ignore_loganalyzer']
            kwargs.pop('ignore_loganalyzer')

        if loganalyzer:
            for _, dut_loganalyzer in loganalyzer.items():
                dut_loganalyzer.add_start_ignore_mark()

>       res = func(*args, **kwargs)
E       TypeError: config_reload() got an unexpected keyword argument 'ignore_loganalyzer'

comments.author: yejianquan
comments.body:
> I still see this error when disabled loganalyzer:
> 
> > res = func(*args, **kwargs) E TypeError: config_reload() got an unexpected keyword argument 'ignore_loganalyzer'
> 
> This happens if this test case fails and config reloads is done by test script to recover: ERROR pc/test_po_update.py::test_po_update_io_no_loss <<<< This is a different issue being debugged but config reload should work.

Hi @anamehra , I just noticed the issue, sorry for the late reply.
The ignore_loganalyzer decorator adds a parameter "ignore_loganalyzer" on the decorated functions to dynamically disable loganalyzer without modifying the source code of the decorated functions.
Before running the decorated functions, the "ignore_loganalyzer" should be removed automatically.
If it's reproducible on your side, can you please help to debug and check what's the content of args and kwargs?
I would suspect if kwargs = {'ignore_loganalyzer': None} may cause the issue.
